scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The metric is the intrinsic Euclidean metric inherited from the full graph Laplacian column embedding, not a lattice-coordinate reduction.
Ridge energy is the unweighted sum of squared interior dihedral cosines; area-weighted measures and exact acute-ridge census are not covered.
The proof is analytical; finite rational checks only validate small instances and normalization.
Historical priority is provisional because a relevant publicly indexed general angle-reconstruction text was unavailable for full-text comparison.
title: Hamming dihedral spectrum and edge-localized angular energy of hypercube Laplacian simplices
